verdict.rationale: Lovable supports git-based versioning and review via GitHub/GitLab sync, PR review, and branch testing (lovable-docs-2, -14, -20, -33), which covers versioning and review of the generated codebase. However, there is no explicit documentation of an in-app rollback/revert mechanism for automations (chat history revert, version restore) distinct from relying on git history. missing for 10: explicit rollback/version-restore feature documentation, independent confirmation of rollback working in practice.
